name: post-c3762813 autonomous mechanism closure-envelope audit v1
question: After applying the expanded combat-local design authority to every new immutable closure through c3762813, does one distinct autonomous mechanism class or one decision-valued policy method remain, or is the relevant #421 package-support gate unavailable under the current authority contract?

competingHypotheses.H1: At least one exact class remains evidence-backed, materially distinct, within autonomous authority and not closed or unavailable at cap; or one policy method has a decision-changing open target and measured decision value.
competingHypotheses.H0: Every exact class is closed, unavailable at its valid cap or outside current autonomous authority, and no policy method has a decision-changing open target with measured decision value.
competingHypotheses.HI: The supplied immutable evidence or authority cannot establish partition completeness or the decision boundary at cap.

classDefinitions.C1_EXISTING_COMBAT_STATE_ZONE_OR_AUTHORE: A mechanism composed only from current authored combat state, zones, effects or operator roots.
classDefinitions.C2_NEW_FIGHT_LOCAL_STATE_CARRIER_OR_TRAN: A new combat-lifetime counter, tag, card token, status, target memory or state transform that never enters run/save identity.
classDefinitions.C3_COMBAT_ACTION_SCHEDULING_OR_TRACE_TRA: A unary structural change to card or enemy action order, multiplicity, timing, target, realised type or realised-result guard.
classDefinitions.C4_NATIVE_RUN_ACQUISITION_OR_REWARD_ROUT: An existing reward, shop, event, deed, boss-relic, removal or other current run route reused without a new persistent or presentation contract.
classDefinitions.C5_NEW_PERSISTENT_RUN_OR_PRESENTATION_CO: A new save/internal-ID/relic ownership field, run-persistent selector, choice screen, choice timing, UI or acquisition contract.
classDefinitions.C6_EXTERNAL_PRIMARY_RULE_TOPOLOGY: A materially distinct combat topology selected from the preregistered official-rule evidence methods rather than invented from model preference.

partitionJustification: The prior structural boundary partitions mechanisms by existing combat semantics, new combat-lifetime representation, run/acquisition semantics and policy method. The expanded owner authority opened only deterministic combat-local representation. The later source, private-state, enemy-transform, within-action and primary-rule audits supply the exact delta required to subdivide and dispose that newly opened class. Policy method is assessed separately because it selects behaviour rather than defining product semantics.

H1_AUTONOMOUS_CLASS_CLOSURE.question: Does every exact class have a complete immutable disposition, and is any class autonomously eligible?

H2_POLICY_METHOD_DECISION_VALUE.question: Does the newly observed policy-repertoire bottleneck have an open decision target and measured value distinct from the closed policyPackageOrder method gate?

H3_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY.question: Under the exact current task and AI-SDLC authority, what decision follows if no autonomous class or decision-valued method remains?

estimands.class: autonomouslyEligible for each exact class after immutable closure, cap and authority mapping
estimands.method: policyBottleneckIdentified AND openDecisionTargetExists AND measuredDecisionValue AND optimizerAuthorised
estimands.family: number of eligible classes, whether one method is authorised, and the exact authority decision when both are zero

decisionRules.successClass: If every report is COMPLETE, the partition is complete and at least one class is autonomously eligible, freeze exactly the minimum-ranked class for a separate protocol.
decisionRules.successMethod: If no class is eligible but all four method gates pass, freeze exactly one policy-method gate. Do not select an algorithm here.
decisionRules.unavailable: If no class is eligible, the method conjunction fails and current authority requires escalation for an unavailable relevant gate, produce exactly one human-authority package inside #421 while preserving product and protected state.
decisionRules.inconclusive: If any report or partition-completeness judgement is inconclusive, record inconclusive at cap and select nothing.
decisionRules.prohibited: Do not widen the partition, reinterpret a closure, reopen an action-trace or package-order family, add rows or create a successor after seeing a report.

claimBoundary: This gate can freeze one abstract autonomous class, freeze one policy-method question, or establish that the relevant autonomous mechanism-selection gate is unavailable under the current authority. It cannot select product semantics, change a save/internal-ID/public contract, authorise an optimiser without measured value, accept #421, or issue the #108 P9 receipt.
